This format is also useful for people searching today special day, which day is today, what is today, and today special day in India.Special Days in April 2026 Calendar – Detailed Descriptions🎭 1 April 2026 – April Fool’s DayApril Fool’s Day is known worldwide as a day for harmless pranks, jokes, and playful tricks. It is one of the most popular fun observances of the month and is often searched as what special day is today on 1 April.🌾 1 April 2026 – Odisha Day (Utkala Dibasa)Odisha Day, also called Utkala Dibasa, marks the formation of Odisha as a separate province on 1 April 1936. It is an important state observance in India and a key answer to which special day is today in India on 1 April.🧩 2 April 2026 – World Autism Awareness DayWorld Autism Awareness Day is observed every year on 2 April to promote inclusion, dignity, and support for autistic people. The United Nations established this observance to improve awareness and encourage equal opportunities for individuals on the autism spectrum.🙏 2 April 2026 – Hanuman JayantiIn 2026, Hanuman Jayanti is observed on 2 April in many parts of India. The day celebrates the birth of Lord Hanuman and is marked by temple visits, fasting, bhajans, and Hanuman Chalisa recitation.✝️ 3 April 2026 – Good FridayGood Friday commemorates the crucifixion of Jesus Christ and is observed by Christians as a solemn day of prayer and reflection. In India, Good Friday in 2026 falls on Friday, 3 April.🌸 5 April 2026 – EasterEaster celebrates the resurrection of Jesus Christ and is one of the most important Christian festivals. In 2026, Easter Sunday falls on 5 April and follows Good Friday on 3 April.🌍 7 April 2026 – World Health DayWorld Health Day is celebrated every year on 7 April to mark the anniversary of the founding of the World Health Organization in 1948. It highlights major public health issues and is one of the most important global observances in April.👧👦 10 April 2026 – National Siblings DayNational Siblings Day is celebrated on 10 April to honour the special bond between brothers and sisters. The day is widely observed in personal and social spaces and is often searched as today special day by students and families.🌿 10 April 2026 – World Homoeopathy DayWorld Homoeopathy Day is observed every year on 10 April to mark the birth anniversary of Dr. Samuel Hahnemann, the founder of homoeopathy. In India, the Ministry of Ayush also recognizes the day as an important occasion for promoting awareness of homoeopathy.13 April 2026 – Jallianwala Bagh Massacre Remembrance Day13 April is remembered in India for the Jallianwala Bagh Massacre of 1919, when British troops opened fire on a large crowd of unarmed Indians in Amritsar. This date remains deeply significant in Indian history and freedom struggle remembrance.📘 14 April 2026 – Ambedkar JayantiAmbedkar Jayanti marks the birth anniversary of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, the principal architect of the Indian Constitution. It is observed every year on 14 April and is one of the most important national commemorative days in India.🪔 14 April 2026 – Tamil New YearTamil New Year, also known as Puthandu, marks the beginning of the Tamil calendar year. In 2026, it falls on 14 April and is celebrated with prayers, festive meals, and traditional rituals in Tamil households.🎨 15 April 2026 – World Art DayWorld Art Day is celebrated on 15 April to recognize the importance of art, creativity, and artistic expression in society. UNESCO notes that the day helps reinforce links between art, education, culture, and sustainable development.🎊 15 April 2026 – Bengali New YearBengali New Year, also known as Poila Baisakh or Pohela Boishakh, is celebrated as the first day of the Bengali calendar. In 2026, it falls on 15 April and is observed with cultural events, traditional food, and festive gatherings.🩸 17 April 2026 – World Hemophilia DayWorld Hemophilia Day is observed on 17 April to raise awareness about hemophilia and other inherited bleeding disorders. The World Federation of Hemophilia marks this day globally each year.🏛️ 18 April 2026 – World Heritage DayWorld Heritage Day, officially the International Day for Monuments and Sites, is celebrated every year on 18 April. It promotes awareness about preserving monuments, heritage sites, and cultural history across the world.🌟 19 April 2026 – Akshaya TritiyaAkshaya Tritiya is considered one of the most auspicious days in the Hindu calendar and is associated with prosperity, charity, and new beginnings. In 2026, Akshaya Tritiya falls on 19 April.🕉️ 19 April 2026 – Parshuram JayantiParshuram Jayanti marks the birth anniversary of Lord Parshuram, the sixth incarnation of Lord Vishnu. In 2026, Parshuram Jayanti also falls on 19 April and coincides with Akshaya Tritiya.🏢 21 April 2026 – National Civil Services DayNational Civil Services Day is observed every year on 21 April in India to honour the contribution of civil servants. The date commemorates Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel’s 1947 address, where he referred to civil servants as the “steel frame of India.”🌎 22 April 2026 – Earth DayEarth Day is celebrated on 22 April to support environmental protection and sustainable action. It is one of the world’s most widely recognized environmental observances and remains a major answer to what is today on 22 April.📚 23 April 2026 – World Book and Copyright DayWorld Book and Copyright Day is celebrated every year on 23 April by UNESCO to promote reading, books, publishing, and copyright awareness. It is especially important for students, teachers, authors, and libraries.🗣️ 23 April 2026 – English Language DayEnglish Language Day at the United Nations is celebrated on 23 April to promote multilingualism and the use of English as one of the UN’s official languages. The date is traditionally associated with William Shakespeare.🏘️ 24 April 2026 – National Panchayati Raj DayNational Panchayati Raj Day is observed every year on 24 April in India to recognize local self-governance and democratic decentralization. The day commemorates the implementation of the 73rd Constitutional Amendment relating to Panchayati Raj institutions.🦟 25 April 2026 – World Malaria DayWorld Malaria Day is observed on 25 April to raise awareness about malaria prevention, treatment, and elimination. WHO recognizes the day as an opportunity to mobilize communities and resources against malaria.💃 29 April 2026 – International Dance DayInternational Dance Day is celebrated on 29 April each year to honour dance as a universal art form. It was founded by the International Theatre Institute and is observed on the birth anniversary of Jean-Georges Noverre.🎷 30 April 2026 – International Jazz DayInternational Jazz Day is celebrated every year on 30 April to highlight jazz as a force for peace, dialogue, and cultural unity. UNESCO proclaimed this observance in 2011, and the official Jazz Day platform also notes the 2026 global celebration on 30 April.ConclusionApril is a month filled with cultural, historical, religious, environmental, literary, and health-related observances. From April Fool’s Day and Odisha Day to World Health Day, Ambedkar Jayanti, Earth Day, and International Jazz Day, the month offers many important national and international events.
